sections.heading: Commercial Door Hardware and Closer Repair
sections.body: Beyond the glass itself, commercial doors rely on a network of hardware components to function smoothly and safely. When any of these components fail, the entire door system can become a liability. Our technicians are skilled at diagnosing hardware failures quickly and sourcing compatible replacement parts for a wide range of commercial door brands and configurations. We serve office buildings, retail centers, medical facilities, restaurants, and mixed-use developments across Rockville, including properties near the King Farm community and along the Rockville Pike commercial corridor. Properly maintained hardware not only extends the life of your doors but also supports smooth operation for employees, customers, and visitors entering and exiting your facility throughout the day.
